A1.justification: C2-Evo is renamed SyncLoop, but the framework, experimental series and Appendix A clearly identify the same research work. Both PDFs provide readable text, equations, figures, tables and appendices sufficient for comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments over three model-evolution iterations, benchmark results in Table 2, and ablations in Tables 3–6 and Appendix Table VIII.

after.justification: v3 retains original model-evolution experiments and ablations, with revised results in Table 2. Its empirical evidence is not limited to results attributed to other work.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same diagram augmentation, question generation, answer filtering, difficulty selection, SFT and GRPO procedures. Renaming C2-Evo to SyncLoop does not introduce a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions explicitly specify Geometry3K training, Geo-Sub/Geo-Sub-Aux, MathVista Test Mini and full MathVerse evaluation. v3 removes the MathVerse result column, but Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1 retain its evaluation; the result deletion alone does not establish changed dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 2 substantially revises the principal MathVista comparator set: LLaVA-CoT-11B and AtomThink-LlamaV are removed, while MGT-PerceReason, R1-Onevision-7B and R1-VL-7B are added with reported scores. R1-Onevision and R1-VL were already cited in v1, but were not comparator rows there.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1 retain the same dataset splits, model sizes, training parameters, rollout schedule and evaluation settings. The revised Table 2 caption clarifies result provenance but does not document a protocol revision or establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The training-schedule, error-threshold and image-complexity ablations in Tables 3–6 are retained. The reasoning-length analysis, qualitative example, difficulty distributions and first-iteration ablation in Appendix A.3–A.4 also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance-test results. v3 adds a checklist assertion that error bars or significance information are reported, but provides no corresponding estimates or procedures. The existing 32-generation difficulty assessment is unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises the 7B iterations' Geo-Sub-Aux scores from 48.7/50.9/54.9 to 46.9/48.0/52.4 and MathVista ALL from 62.3/62.7/63.4 to 62.1/62.4/63.2, without a stated setting change. All MathVerse scores disappear. Newly included MathVista scores are 63.2 for MGT-PerceReason, 64.1 for R1-Onevision and 63.6 for R1-VL, changing the reported comparative ranking. The ablation results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The task formulation, assumptions about external tools and models, and objectives in Equations 1–2 are unchanged. The new checklist's statement about proofs supplies no additional theorem, mathematical assumption, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about joint multimodal evolution, alignment of difficulty with model capability, and iterative reasoning improvements. The revised title makes the existing mathematical focus explicit without changing the substantive contribution.

C2.justification: The explanations of training schedules, difficulty filtering and joint image/text complexification remain unchanged. Both versions retain the geometry-domain and synthetic-data limitations and Appendix A.3's catastrophic-forgetting interpretation. The revised results are not accompanied by revised interpretations.

D1.justification: The abstract's release commitment narrows from code, models and datasets to code; v3's checklist still places code release after acceptance. Table 2 adds clearer attribution of published versus reproduced scores. Hardware, hyperparameters and implementation instructions remain unchanged, and neither PDF establishes actual resource release.

R1.justification: The bibliography removes the AtomThink and LLaVA-o1 works associated with the deleted comparator rows. MGT-PerceReason appears with an unresolved citation. The substantive related-work discussion and positioning against approaches such as OpenVLThinker and MM-EUREKA remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 retitles and renames the framework, adds Yongxin Wang, revises affiliations and appends a standard NeurIPS checklist. The scientific narrative, section organization and explanatory prose otherwise remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 changes comparator rows, removes the MathVerse column, expands source markers and changes highlighted rows from red to blue. It moves above the benchmark-description continuation, and Appendix Table VIII moves from page 14 to page 13. Existing scientific figures are retained without substantive redesign.

improvement.justification: The added comparators and clearer score provenance are useful, but v3 removes MathVerse evidence while retaining three-benchmark claims. Section 4.2 still reports 54.9 despite Table 2 now reporting 52.4, and its superiority statement is no longer supported by the newly expanded comparison. These unreconciled reporting changes weaken empirical clarity and support, producing a limited net decline while the method and ablations remain intact.
